name: AquaPure RO-5000 Reverse Osmosis (POU)
blurb: 5-stage under-sink RO. NSF/ANSI 58 certified for lead, arsenic V, nitrate, and copper reduction at the tap.

name: CarbonBlock Pro 0.5µm (POU)
blurb: NSF/ANSI 53 certified lead + VOC reduction. Removes disinfection by-products (TTHM/HAA5) and chlorine taste.

name: WholeHouse CarbonGuard 1.5cf (POE)
blurb: Catalytic carbon backwashing tank for chloramine, TTHM/HAA5, and VOC reduction across the entire building.

name: NitrateShield Ion-Exchange (POE)
blurb: Nitrate-selective resin tank. Designed for systems exceeding 10 mg/L nitrate-N MCL.

name: ArsenicOut Adsorption Tank (POE)
blurb: Granular ferric oxide media targeting arsenic III/V. NSF/ANSI 61 components, sized to community-system flow.

name: PFAS-X Dual-Bed (POE)
blurb: Single-use IX resin + GAC polish. Targets EPA's 2024 PFAS MCL of 4 ppt for PFOA/PFOS.

name: DBP Mitigation Aeration (System)
blurb: Tower-aeration retrofit for storage tanks. Cuts TTHM 40-70% pre-distribution. Engineered install.

name: UV-D Disinfection (POE)
blurb: 40 mJ/cm² NSF/ANSI 55 Class A reactor. For systems with microbial MCL exceedances or boil-water advisories.

name: OrthoPhos Corrosion Control (System)
blurb: Orthophosphate metering skid for distribution-side lead/copper passivation. Often required by state after LCR exceedance.

name: RadShield HMO Tank (POE)
blurb: Hydrous manganese oxide media for radionuclide reduction. Replaces softener-only setups that fail combined-radium MCL.

name: Compliance Pitcher Program (POU bulk)
blurb: Per-household NSF 53 pitcher program. Used as interim mitigation while POE/system fixes are designed.

name: Compliance Audit + Remediation Plan
blurb: Licensed engineer reviews violation history, samples, and infrastructure. Delivers a stamped remediation roadmap acceptable to state regulators.
